:::{#cor-conditional-entropy-difference}
#### Conditional entropy as a difference

For discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ with finite entropies,

$$H(X \mid Y) = H(X, Y) - H(Y).$$

:::

::: {.proof}

Subtract $H(Y)$ from both sides of @cor-entropy-chain-rule-reversed:

$$
\begin{aligned}
H(X, Y) - H(Y)
&= H(X \mid Y) + H(Y) - H(Y) \\
&= H(X \mid Y).
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
